newsitem.title: USA: Gymboree says inventory well positioned.
newsitem.headline: Gymboree says inventory well positioned.

text.p: Gymboree Corp, a maker of children's clothing and accesories, said Wednesday its inventory levels are "well positioned" as it enters the fall selling season.
Gary White, president and chief executive officer, said the company opened 47 new stores through the first half of the year and is on track with its goal of 75 to 80 new stores for the full year.

The company issued the statement as it reported that for the second quarter ended August 2, 1997 it posted net income of $4.6 million, as compared with $4.3 million for the same period last year. Net income per share increased 12 percent to $0.19 per share compared with $0.17 per share last year.
Net sales for the latest quarter 1997 were $71.7 million, an increase of 24 percent from sales of $57.9 million for the same period last year.
